items.heading: Managing subscriptions
items.body: Create a subscription with the orange button. Select a customer to review their plan, usage, and renewal settings.

items.heading: Monitoring revenue
items.body: The overview provides illustrative revenue metrics. Export the subscription register for the current customer records.

items.heading: About this workspace
items.body: This is a local demo. Subscription changes are saved in this browser. No billing actions or emails are sent.
